name: Johannes Ramaekers
abstract_title: Ego dissolution and Self-Other boundaries under psychedelics
abstract: The presentation addresses a fundamental question in psychology and consciousness research: how do humans draw the boundary between their own mental states and the perceived mental states of others, and how flexible is this distinction? Psychedelics have long been described as dissolving the self, yet this experience has resisted precise measurement; where measurement has been attempted, it has been limited to subjective embodiment.
